trajectory_summary: A cooperative, procedural call: customer answers every verify item without resistance and the rep works methodically through the checklist, closing with a booked appointment. But the rep leaves real value on the table — the EV-charging enthusiasm signal and the $150 bill anchor are both captured and never used to build a case, and post-booking, the customer's own curiosity about financing and incentives is met with generic deflection instead of being tied back to his stated motivations.

observed_outcome.reasoning: A specific day (tomorrow) and time (12PM) were mutually agreed. The rep earlier confirmed in-person visit format ('We do come in person') at 03:00. The wife was identified as co-owner at 01:38 but never invited onto the appointment.

bill_anchor_audit.reasoning: The $150 bill was captured at 02:09 but never flipped into emotional leverage; the rep moved straight to bill-document logistics. The flip should have landed around 07:26 when setting the appointment, tying the visit to reducing that $150 plus the coming EV load.
